summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for AgentOps callback handler registration that does not semantically match any existing skill. Existing skills cover locale formatting, process pool configuration, and other unrelated domains. Peer candidates (Session Span Initialization, Singleton Client Initialization, Update legacy global references) are complementary initialization patterns in the same observability domain but target different asset layers and initialization mechanisms. The candidate fills a specific gap: LangchainCallbackHandler instantiation and attachment to LLM and tool instances for automatic span tracking.
